title: Deployment Contract
description: Instance-owned, provider-agnostic statement of the lane model each product repo must implement: which branch deploys which environment, what gates stand between them, and whether rollback is wired. A drift checker diffs this against the repos' actual workflows.

rollback_required.description: top-level convenience; per-lane flag wins when both set

secrets_required.description: deploy secret names the repo must define — names only

branch.description: the lane's integration branch (develop, staging, prod, main, rc/* …)

required_jobs.description: job ids that must exist in the workflow (test, deploy, smoke, rollback…)

rollback_required.description: per-lane override; when omitted the repo-level flag applies (default true)

health_check.description: free-form liveness contract (URL, az command, containerapp revision-health)

concurrency_group.description: expected workflow concurrency group substring — serializes deploys
